answer: The sable counter is kept in kernel and nadir makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 25 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 25 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 36 aliases cost 89 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
